نتضاءل (form VI)
# نَتَضَاءَلُ (nataḍāʔalu) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʔa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# نَتَضَاءَلَ (nataḍāʔala) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʔa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# نَتَضَاءَلْ (nataḍāʔal) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʔal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
